# v2.1.1 — Info-only events, questionnaire templates and open polls

`v2.1.1` is the published container release for the `2.1` feature line (`v2.1.0`
was blocked by the pre-release upgrade rehearsal gate before pushing a container
image, and `#948` fixed the `v2.0.0` rehearsal scenario).

This feature release adds info-only events without RSVPs, structured
questionnaire contact and terms fields with reusable quick-add templates and a
Going-only filter, pre-RSVP potluck visibility, per-poll open voting, and a
cleaner event hero without a dark scrim.

Startup applies three additive database migrations. There are no new environment
variables, and no Cloudflare email worker redeployment is required. See the
[v2.1.0 / v2.1.1 section of the upgrade guide](https://github.com/joe-cole1/rsvp-to-me/blob/main/docs/admin/upgrading.md#v210-release)
before upgrading.

## Changes

### New features

- **Info-only events without RSVPs:** turn off **Collect RSVPs** when creating
  an event or under **Settings → RSVP options** to publish a flyer-style page
  with event details, info sections, open polls, standalone questionnaires, and
  comments while hiding RSVPs, guest lists, invitations, check-ins, potluck,
  message blasts, and reminders. Existing RSVPs and invitations stay saved in
  the database if you turn **Collect RSVPs** back on later. (#843, #942)
- **Questionnaire contact and terms fields, templates, and Going-only filter:**
  add **Phone number** (works even when SMS notifications are off and never
  sends text alerts or verification codes), **Mailing address** (structured
  street, unit, city, state/region, postal code, and country fields), and
  **Terms / waiver** (scrollable text and/or external `http(s)` link with an
  agreement checkbox) field types, optional question blurbs, six one-click
  quick-add templates (Mailing address, Phone number, Dietary restrictions,
  Emergency contact, Accessibility, Terms / waiver), and a per-question
  **Going only** option. (#786, #943)
- **Pre-RSVP potluck visibility and per-poll RSVP toggle:** visitors can view
  the potluck list and remaining quantities before RSVPing (claiming still
  requires an approved **Going** RSVP, and claimer names follow the event's
  guest-list privacy setting), and hosts can turn off **Require RSVP to
  respond** on individual polls so visitors can vote before RSVPing with
  browser-linked votes that attach if they RSVP later. (#696, #879, #941)

### UI and accessibility

- Remove the dark hero background scrim so event covers and headers display
  cleanly while keeping theme contrast readable. (#944)

### Maintenance

- Remove the temporary `brace-expansion` compatibility shim, `.npmrc`, and
  package overrides now that upstream lint packages resolve patched
  `brace-expansion` natively. (#546, #945)
- Batch weekly Dependabot updates with major-only package-family groups and
  automatic squash-merge for eligible patch and minor updates. (#938, #939, #940)
- Update `@testing-library/jest-dom` to 8.0.0 (#928) and clarify ADR 0002
  rollback wording (#927).
- Add `v2.0.0` baseline scenario support to the pre-release upgrade rehearsal and
  align `saveNotificationSchedule`, stale-upload sweep allowances, and per-probe
  Redis resets (`#946`, `#948`).
- Wait for settled transition focus in the `#853` RSVP feedback regression test (`#947`).

## Upgrade from v2.0.0

1. Record the running image digest, `pg_dump` the database, copy `data/uploads`,
   and back up `.env`. Keep `.env` unchanged.
2. No `.env` changes or Cloudflare email worker redeployments are required.
3. Stop every old app instance. In your deployment Compose file, pin the app
   image to `ghcr.io/joe-cole1/rsvp-to-me:2.1.1` after the Release workflow has
   published it. With the standard production configuration, run:

   ```bash
   docker compose -f docker-compose.release.yml pull app
   docker compose -f docker-compose.release.yml up -d --no-deps app
   docker compose -f docker-compose.release.yml logs --tail=100 app
   ```

4. Startup writes `data/backups/pre-migration/pre-migration-schema_*.sql`,
   applies three additive migrations (`20261126120000_poll_require_rsvp`,
   `20261127000000_info_only_events`, and
   `20261127010000_questionnaire_field_types_and_templates`), and verifies
   saved v2 provider credentials (`0 converted, ... verified; v2 ready.`).
5. Check health, sign-in, info-only event creation with standalone
   questionnaire/comments, questionnaire templates and Going-only fields,
   pre-RSVP potluck visibility and open-poll voting, hero display, and delivery
   through each enabled email and SMS provider.

*(Upgrading directly from v1.5.0? Work through the
[v2.0.0 breaking-change checklist](https://github.com/joe-cole1/rsvp-to-me/blob/main/docs/admin/upgrading.md#breaking-change-checklist)
first.)*

## Rollback and known limitations

- **If no event has created `PHONE`, `ADDRESS`, or `TERMS` questionnaire fields
  on v2.1.1:** an image-only rollback to `v2.0.0` starts and serves existing
  events. While rolled back, the new `2.1` columns and tables (`rsvpEnabled`,
  `requireRsvp`, `goingOnly`, `description`, `voterTokenHash`, and standalone
  questionnaire tables) are ignored, so info-only events show RSVPs again and
  all polls require an RSVP until you upgrade back.
- **If any event created `PHONE`, `ADDRESS`, or `TERMS` questionnaire fields on
  v2.1.1:** `v2.0.0` cannot read those new `RSVPFieldType` enum values. Either
  delete or convert those fields before rolling back, or restore your
  pre-upgrade `pg_dump` (or `pre-migration-schema_*.sql` snapshot) into
  a fresh database with `psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1`, which loses data received
  after the upgrade. See the
  [v2.1.x rollback guide](https://github.com/joe-cole1/rsvp-to-me/blob/main/docs/admin/upgrading.md#rolling-back-v210-to-v200).

Builds still download the remaining Google fonts through Next.js and can
encounter the tracked upstream font-query failure. Fonts are served locally at
runtime. Provider tests use mocks; passing CI does not confirm delivery through
your live email or SMS account.

See the [upgrade guide](https://github.com/joe-cole1/rsvp-to-me/blob/main/docs/admin/upgrading.md)
for backup, verification, and release approval procedures.

**Full comparison:** https://github.com/joe-cole1/rsvp-to-me/compare/v2.0.0...v2.1.1
